management_liability.description: Courts can prohibit management from exercising functions (time-limited ban) for persistent non-compliance. Management must undergo training. MCF authorized to issue training regulations.

supply_chain_requirements.description: Cannot be limited to direct suppliers only. Must assess vulnerabilities at sub-suppliers and subsequent chain links. Supplier agreements must address information sharing and sub-supplier accountability.

competent_authority.name: Swedish Civil Contingencies Agency (now Swedish Civil Defence Authority)

compliance_deadlines.note: No grace period - immediate compliance required from entry into force (2026-01-15)

penalties.essential_entities: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of global annual turnover (min SEK 5,000)
penalties.important_entities: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of global annual turnover (min SEK 5,000)
